reviews.t: This is what I have been looking for!
reviews.x: This is an amazing moisturizer.  It's light, sinks right into the skin, and leaves a nice glow.  It doesn't have the typical heaviness, greasiness or odor that is usually associated with moisturizers that include SPF.  One caveat, the container is small.  I use this product only during the day (at night I use AHA's Night Replenishing Crème), and I go through a container about once every month and a half or so.  The price is so reasonable though, I usually buy two at a time.  As a bonus -

I love this moisturizer and the glow it imparts. I don't wear foundation. With the glow this and the 10% cream provides it isn't necessary. My skin is virtually flawless. Not too shabby for a 34 yr old!

First off, let me say that every Alpha Hydrox product I have tried, I have absolutely loved. I call the souffle 'face crack' because I am addicted to it. I used the moisturizer as part of my morning routine, after applying the souffle. Unfortunately, this product did not work well for me. I'm not sure what ingredients my skin objected to, but I developed an odd red rash on my temple and upper lip. I didn't want to attribute the skin problems to this moisturizer, but after I stopped using it and

I've tried so many different sunscreens. I've had my dark spots IPL'd off, and good UVA protection is essential to keep them from recurring. This means a physical sunscreen, with zinc oxide (not titanium dioxide, which doesn't cover as much of the UVA spectrum). The problem is that most zinc oxide sunscreens are terrible for facial use. They are thick and leave a white/gray powdering finish (just perfect for highlighting and magnifying every pore, wrinkle, dry patch, and blemish).  This sunscree
Slides very nicely over the Alpha Hydrox gel. Moisturizes but doesn't make my skin greasy- not matte, but dewy. No break-outs with this plus there's SPF!

This is a great product.  It goes on smoothly and does not leave any greasy residue.  My skin feels so soft and clean to the touch.  It really does seem to minimize lines and wrinkles too.  I am 68 so I did not expect miracles but I must say, this cream does make my skin look younger and more supple.  I have tried other moisturizing facial creams and the others either seemed to do nothing or left my skin feeling oily.  Love that it is SPF 15 also since I use it all year but do add more stronger
I use this in conjunction with alpha hydroxy treatment.  It feels smooth going on.  I would recommend this to anyone using alpha hydroxy treatments.

I contacted the seller and was informed that was the proper amount for the tube, but the odor was not even mentioned.  I have purchased several Alpha Hydroxy products and they have always been mostly unscented and the tubes were at least 3/4+ full. I currently use their eye cream which is in a tube and after a month of daily use it's still at least 3/4 full.  I have no idea if the product normally

reviews.t: I like it but wish they made a lotion that was oil-free
reviews.x: I have an allergic reaction to oil-based moisturizers. So far, if I do not use this everyday, I seem to be okay. However, the oil will keep me from purchasing it in the future. However, I can vouch for it being smooth, going on cleanly, and despite the oil, not being greasy. It is a good moisturizer if you do not have the same allergic reaction to oil products that I have.
I loved it, smoth and smelled good, not greasy.  Easy to use.  I will buy it again and again.  Perfect.

I so badly want to write a great review on this product because I think Alpha Hydrox makes amazing stuff. Seriously, try the oil free kind topped off with retinol and your skin will be transformed. Usually products contain active ingredients in such small doses that there is no noticeable difference but not Alpha Hydrox. I had to shake the tube and push from the end of the tube to get the moisturizer to come out. I held it up to a bright light and could see that the tube was less than half full. reviews.t: You do not need much for it to work
reviews.x: As I get older I find my oily skin is getting dryer and dryer.  I find with this product  that, after about a month my skin is much softer and I do not need a lot so it should last me a long time.  I play squash at least twice a week and I use it after every shower.  My skin even has a bit of a glow to it as well
The product is good, but tube is only half full. I feel cheated when the container is much bigger than the contents.
Best moisturizer I've ever bought, I've been loyally purchasing for 10 years.

Great stuff so far. It leaves me moisturized and glowy. It is sheer and doesn't leave me oily either. I have been using it every day before I go out. I have been using it in conjunction with the souffle (2x's a week). I use the 20% pads once a week in the evening after a shower. I wait about 15 minuets and then I use Burt Bees radiance eye cream and Lumene dry skin cocktail with vitamin C and artic cloudberries on top. I have combo skin but I can get pretty dry in the fall/winter months. This doesn't cut it during that time. But it's a good summer moisturizer, especially here in TX where we have many days over 100 degrees. It's light and doesn't make me greasy, even in T-zone. reviews.t: This feels nice and I was going to re-order
reviews.x: This feels nice and I was going to re-order, but I noticed Alpha Hydrox is offering a new one, under the name of Alpha.  The new one is SPF30, so I ordered that instead.  I guess they are changing their whole line over to this new name?  This one is offered in a 3 oz. tube, which will last a lot longer than the old 1 oz. tube.

reviews.t: This is my all time favorite moisturizer. I've used it for many years
reviews.x: This is my all time favorite moisturizer. I've used it for many years. I've tried others, but always come back to this one, mainly because it's not heavy or oily. My skin is extremely sensitive and I can't use just anything. Luckily this works and is quite inexpensive, compared to most.
i HAD TWO SUN SPOTS ON MY FACE AND THIS PRODUCT HAS ACTUALLY LIGHTENED THOSE SPOTS. I HAVE USED IT FOR ABOUT THREE WEEKS. I CAN TELL A DIFFERENCE AND WOULD DEFINATELY BUY AGAIN.
Soothing light moisturizer with the added bonus of SPF 15. I use this after applying Alpha Hydro 10% Glycolic AHA Anti-Wrinkle Enhanced Lotion. They work well together.

reviews.t: Not much of a difference I see
reviews.x: It is your basic day cream. You get what you pay for in terms of seeing a difference in your skin pretty much a preventative wrinkle day lotion no big deal!
Nice moisturizer that doesn't feel greasy. Like that it has SPF in it. Have been using this product for a few years. Have always been happy with results.

reviews.t: My face has never looked so good for a guy at age 41
reviews.x: My face has never looked so good for a guy at age 41. Non greasy, peels old skin gradually. Perfect timing for xmas.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the moisturizer for going on smoothly, absorbing well, and leaving skin soft and dewy without greasiness.
Many reviewers love the glow it gives their skin, with some saying it makes foundation unnecessary.
Several reviewers complain that the tube arrives only about half full, making them feel cheated.
Some reviewers report problems with the product, including an old smell, an allergic reaction to the oil base, and it not working for their skin.
Reviewers value the SPF and UVA protection, with one noting it avoids the heaviness and odor typical of SPF moisturizers.
